title: Further law-text captures named by the step-P4 readers as not had (the definition of floor area ratio; the front and side yard requirements for R6 to R12; the page of ZR 34-23 and its sub-sections; further ZR 12-10 definitions; the scope of Article III Chapter 5): source text only (D-090 R291)
objective: Capture, as source text only, the law texts that the two step-P4 readers named as not among their texts and that their answers wait for (docs/reference-cases/R6B/cases/step-p4-worked.json row `sections-and-facts-not-had`; the two readings under docs/reference-cases/R6B/provenance/, files 9 and 10, each at its Q10), from the official Zoning Resolution site, each in a file of its own under docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ in the form of the existing captures, with the synced copy under services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/. THE TARGETS, named by what they are and NOT by guessed section numbers (the builder finds each on the official site and reports its section number, title and page): (1) the ZR 12-10 definition of 'floor area ratio' (the unit count of the reference cases is conditional on it); (2) the sections that state the front yard and the side yard REQUIREMENTS for residences in R6 through R12 districts, or the section that says none is required there (whether the overlay's 'no front yard' and 'no side yard' change anything against plain R6B waits for them); (3) the section the text of ZR 23-443(a) points to for zoning lots adjoining public parks; (4) the section on balconies that ZR 23-341 and ZR 23-312 point to; (5) these ZR 12-10 definitions, each whole: 'Limited Height District', 'aggregate width of street walls', 'block', 'short dimension of a block' (or the article that defines it), 'transportation-infrastructure-adjacent frontage', 'Greater Transit Zone', 'Outer Transit Zone', 'multiple dwelling residence', 'height factor', 'open space', 'open space ratio' and 'public park'; (6) the opening sections of Article III, Chapter 5 that state to which buildings the chapter applies (the readings could not say whether ZR 35-22 or ZR 34-111 formally governs an all-residential building); (7) the page of ZR 34-23 itself and the list of its sub-sections as the official site shows it (one reading holds the rear-yard answer subject to the capture of ZR 34-23 holding only its title line: capture what the page shows, its child sections by number and title, and say whether any child exists beyond 34-231, 34-232 and 34-233; the existing capture `zr-34-23` is NOT edited: if the page shows more than it holds, capture the list as a separate file and say so); (8) ZR 23-20 and its opening text, if a page of its own exists. For each target: search the exact title, the inverted title ('yard, front') and combined titles ('residence, or residential'); a term is reported as 'not defined in ZR 12-10' ONLY after all three and with the search shown. A term defined inside another article is captured with that article whole. Tables cell by cell. Each capture carries the page address, the time of each request, the amendment date the page shows, the verbatim text and its digests, and the channel used (the print/PDF channel where it answers; the disclosed fallback where it does not). The captures are NOT a reading: no rule, no reference case, no register entry and no result changes, and the report draws no conclusion about what any text means for a lot.
business_reason: Step 3 of the owner's eight steps (R291) is not finished while answers of the reference cases wait for text nobody has captured: the unit count is conditional on the definition of 'floor area ratio'; the rear-yard answer under the overlay carries a caveat about ZR 34-23 that only the official page can close; the yards and the height provisions point to sections and terms the readers did not have. Capturing them is the first half; the independent reading follows in a later task.
